title: Wastewater Contaminate Removal for Groundwater Recharge at Water Factory 21
lineage: Paraphrased research notes, not a source copy.

passages.note: The EPA report states that the Orange County Water District built Water Factory 21, began injection in the second operating period in October 1976, and added reverse osmosis later. It reports 15 million gallons per day as design, not achieved, flow.
